title: Guidelines for Teachers and Schools on Handling of Students with SEN
what_it_is: Guidelines for Teachers and Schools on Handling of Students with SEN

sections.label: Support for SEN students
sections.summary: The Ministry provides guidelines, information, video resources and teacher training to support students with special educational needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry provides guidelines, information and video resources to schools to support students with special educational needs (SEN).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Through Teaching and Learning Guides, all teachers are provided with practical strategies to support the learning of diverse learners, including students with SEN.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: All new teachers undergo basic training covering how to engage students with SEN during their pre-service training.

sections.label: Trained teachers and SEN officers
sections.summary: Schools have Teachers Trained in Special Needs and SEN Officers, and MOE facilitates sharing of best practices.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Each school also has Teachers Trained in Special Needs who have completed a 130-hour certificate-level course conducted by the National Institute of Education.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: All mainstream schools also have SEN Officers who work with school personnel to develop customised interventions to support the specific needs of students with SEN, particularly those with higher needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) facilitates systematic sharing of best practices among mainstream schools, as well as between mainstream schools and Special Education schools.

sections.label: SEN Resource Portal
sections.summary: The SEN Resource Portal offers schools structures, guidelines and resources to support students with SEN.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: First, we have the SEN Resource Portal and this offers schools with the structures, the guidelines and the resources to support students with SEN.

sections.label: Flexibility in SEN training hours
sections.summary: The exact number of SEN training hours is not available, but teachers have flexibility to access additional modules.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: In terms of the specific number of hours in terms of SEN, I do not have the exact number of hours that we have for our teachers, but suffice to say, they have the flexibility to look at what lessons they require, what additional modules they wish to be able to have; and they can apply that in turn, because it is readily accessible for them.
